name: PRETERNATURAL
source:
You've been having sleeping problems as of late. You've chalked them up to stress causing nightmares, but unfortunately for you, the reality is much more... terrifying. 

Learn about what's really going on from a poltergeist that resides in your home, who also happens to be deeply in love with you.

[From [url=https://chercookue.itch.io/preternatural]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
最近，你總是睡不好。你以為只是壓力太大，導致惡夢纏身，可惜，真相比這要……可怕得多。

從寄居在你家中的騷靈口中，瞭解究竟發生了什麼。而這隻騷靈，恰好還深深地愛著你。

[摘自[url=https://chercookue.itch.io/preternatural]Itch.io[/url]]
